title: Arcturus Military Wool Blanket - Warm, Thick, Washable - Great for Outdoors, Camping, Stadium Blanket, Picnics, Travel - Car & Bushcraft Survival Kits

reviews.title: Great value for great blanket
reviews.body: This blanket is a perfect size to use around the house, in the car, camping, wherever. It's big enough for one person to wrap up completely or two people to share over top.  It has a good feel, nice and soft and heavy.  When I first opened the package it did have a very strong diesel-like aroma.  I know that's just the strong smell of lanolin and how my nose interprets it, but it is pretty powerful.  After a gentle wash, the smell was mostly gone and it now just smells like a wool blanket.  The color is a rich burnt orange that I love (less bright/vibrant than the pictures in the listing).  This is not a $500 artisanal wool blanket but for the price you're getting a great wool blanket for a good value.  I've seen some "wool" blankets in stores that are 90+ percent synthetic with some tiny fraction of wool for the same price or even more.  This is the way to go.  I'm ordering another one in a different color based on my experience so far.  By the time I'm done I'll probably have one for everyone in the family.Update:  bought the blue version.  It had almost no smell at all but felt just as substantial.  Washed and dried and it is comfy and warm.  Also used some webbing and buckles I had to make a blanket roll/carrier for each.  If Arcturus is reading these reviews I wish they did a bundled version that included one for a reasonable price instead of as a separate item.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 7, 2025
reviews.author: AmazedAtTheWorld

reviews.title: Very Cozy
reviews.body: To start, it should be noted that this does have a chemical smell to start. It does fade with time and use. I think I’ve had mine just over a month, and it’s gone.It also is a little coarse, but it is wool, so surprise.  Not unbearably so, and there’s also that contradictory, yet true, softness to it.It’s dense, thickly woven, on the heavy side, and pretty warm. Obviously, if you’re sleeping naked you won’t be as warm as if you pulled this over you to watch tv or fell asleep in sweatpants and a sweatshirt.  For those of you who watch tv naked, the same applies.It’s marketed as an outdoorsy blanket,m and one of the pictures shows a guy outside with it draped over him while it’s snowing.  Wool does retain a good portion of its warmth while wet, but I wouldn’t advise it if this is a vital portion of your camp bedding. It’s one thing if you’re at the cabin and want to drape it over you while around the fire and enjoying the first snow of the season and another all together if you’re carrying it out with your camp pad in the early spring or fall and expecting it to keep you warm.  You’ll likely be a bit more miserable, if not at risk.I got it as my primary blanket for a prolonged stay with a friend/housesitting/dogsitting where I had to show up earlier than expected and they weren’t completely prepared.  So I ordered some of my own bedding. No biggie.  Especially since I ended up with this. Perfect as the primary blanket for a twin bed, like I was staying on. A very cozy sleep.The weight makes me think it’d be good for those with conditions where that helps them.  If they were ok with the texture.  Might want to have dad break it in on the couch for awhile though, to get the odor out. He’ll want his own.Definitely a worthwhile purchase.

reviews.author: Sean Smith

reviews.title: Warm, tough, and an incredible value
reviews.body: I bought the Arcturus Military Wool Blanket for camping and car emergency use, and it has quickly become one of my most-used pieces of gear. This thing is seriously impressive for the price. The blanket is thick, heavy (about 4.5 lbs), and feels very high quality. The 80% wool blend keeps you surprisingly warm even when it’s damp or cold outside — a huge advantage over synthetic blankets. I’ve used it on chilly nights while camping and as an extra layer in my sleeping bag, and it performed beautifully. At 64" x 88", it’s large enough to wrap up comfortably or use as a ground cloth. The weave is tight and durable, and it looks like it will hold up for years of outdoor abuse. I also love that it’s machine washable — a big plus compared to many pure wool blankets that require special care.I was worried it might be itchy, but after one wash it softened up nicely. It still has that classic wool feel, but it’s very tolerable now. Honestly, for the money, this blanket offers outstanding value. It feels and performs like blankets that cost twice as much. Whether you’re building a bushcraft kit, stocking your car for emergencies, going camping, or just want a warm stadium or picnic blanket, this one checks all the boxes. Highly recommend! I’ll probably end up buying a second one.

reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.title: Good quality, NORMAL wool scent, excellent value.
reviews.body: No odor whatsoever upon arrival. If you bury your nose in the blanket and REALLY REALLY sniff hard, you might catch a tiny bit of normal "wool scent." Every wool blanket I have ever encounterd has the same scent. No biggie. It is genuine wool and smells no different than a wool sweater. No massive shedding, either. Maybe I got lucky and got a "good one," but I doubt that. I really question the hysterical one-star ratings for this blanket, which almost caused me to not purchase it. They are doing Arcturus a big disservice with the ridiculous hysteria. (I am not affiliated with Arcturus, I am just a normal customer.) If one has a wool allergy of course this will not be a good buy for you, but your allergy or over-sensitive nose is not a reason to give a one-star rating. The blanket is medium heavy (4.5 pounds advertised) and very warm. It feels hefty and and comforting without pinning you down with sheer weight. Normal and typical "wool scratchy," which is not scratchy but rough compared to fabrics like cotton. Again, not abnormal. The edges are bound with quality stitching.  I like this blanket so much I that have recommended it to family members, and the $45 price makes this a great value. This blanket is going to live in the back seat of my pickup as a passenger comfort blanket / survival blanket.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 10, 2025
reviews.author: Tom N

reviews.title: Legit blanket
reviews.body: This is clearly a well-made product. And I was impressed with the weight of it. Definitely a substantial blanket. The only negatives that I can see are there is a bit of a bad scent to it when I first got it, but it seems to have dissipated now. And it’s a little bit itchy, but I suspect that that would be improved if I washed it. Unfortunately, it says that it should not be put in a washing machine, especially not one with an agitator. But it’s too big for me to try to wash it and dry it in my shower. So I’m not really sure how I’m going to clean it. But it’s made in America and if you need something warm, I would recommend it.

reviews.author: kevin

reviews.title: Perfect for Camping and Cold Weather, Super Warm and Durable
reviews.body: This Arcturus Military Wool Blanket is absolutely perfect for camping, outdoor adventures, and even just keeping cozy at home. I’ve been incredibly impressed with the quality, warmth, and durability of this blanket, so much so that I’ve purchased one for every member of my family. The 64" x 88" size is more than enough to keep you warm whether you're alone or sharing it with someone, and the 4.5 lb weight gives it a nice heft without feeling too bulky.One of the best things about this blanket is its ability to keep you warm even when it’s wet. Wool is a fantastic material for regulating body heat, and this blanket does exactly that. I’ve used it in a variety of outdoor conditions, and it has always kept me cozy. The 80% wool composition, along with 20% synthetic fibers, not only provides excellent warmth but also adds durability and makes it machine washable, which is a big plus. After a few washes, it gets even softer and more comfortable.I love that this blanket is loom-woven with hemmed edges and contrast stitching, giving it a rugged yet polished look that fits in whether you’re out in the wilderness or using it on the couch at home. The fact that it’s naturally fire-retardant without any added chemicals is another bonus, especially for those who want to avoid unnecessary treatments.Yes, there is a very light solvent smell when you first unpack it, but it’s honestly to be expected with wool blankets of this type. After a wash or two, the smell completely fades, and it doesn’t detract from the overall experience.In terms of value for money, this blanket is top-notch. It’s durable, washable, and designed to last for years. Whether you’re using it for camping, emergencies, or just keeping warm during winter, it’s a great investment. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a reliable, long-lasting, and incredibly warm blanket!

reviews.title: Great for you and pets too!
reviews.body: This wool blanket is dense, warm, and holds up well to outdoor elements- so it's a great choice for camping, keeping as a just-in-case blanket for the car, or even in place of a duvet. I've used it both outside and inside, and it really holds up well against the sun, water (when I forget it outside during a storm), and cold/windy days. It doesn't hold smells long, at least as far as I've seen, but I do air it outside a lot. Not the softest wool blanket, but it has softened more after several months of use, and it's a great quality for the price.While I've used it myself in order to fully review it, I actually purchased this for my cats. They absolutely LOVE this wool blanket. As soon as I put it down they're all over it. They use it as a bed, play with it like a toy, and climb across like spider monkeys or do zoomies through it when it's draped over something. I also used it as a crate cover and it works great since it big and heavier than a typical blanket, making it easy to place over the crate without too much sliding. As a crate cover it blocked out pretty much all light (I bought a darker color), so the cats can have a nice dark area for sleeping/hiding.One downside it that is does shed like crazy while being washed (but that's pretty typical of the wool products I've gotten). I first handwashed it with Woolite, and it shed a ton. Then washing machine, and it shed all over the washer (though not as much as the first wash). Shedding isn't nearly as bad after the first few washings. As a warning, it's super heavy when soaking wet.Overall I'm very happy with this product and plan on purchasing another soon!Edit:  Still a great product after 1 year of use, no issues with fabric or stitching even with cats clawing all over it. The charcoal black color has only faded a little while being in the sun and outdoor elements pretty much 24/7. The 2nd blanket I got in green shed A LOT less compared to the previous one I bought. I'm thinking the new blanket design sheds less than before, which is great.I also used 2 blankets to help keep a feral cat I trapped and spayed warm during the nights until I released it, to cover both the trap and crate and keep the heat in. Worked fantastic! Going to buy another before the winter cold sets in this year.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 26, 2023
